# Controls

This page lists each hook, guard, cap, and notice of claudetto.
Each row names the incident that the control exists for and the condition that removes it.

| Slice | Control | Incident | Remove When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `claudetto/agents` | `roster and agent offer` | A call to `Agent` with no `subagent_type` needs a default, and the built-in agents add text to the request (see [Agents](Agents)). | Claude Code lets a plugin set the roster and the default with no hook. |
| `claudetto/decide` | `AskUserQuestion pick` | The user had to answer a choice that the project or Jev settles (trim design, decision 9, and D66). | Claude settles such a choice from the project with no hook. |
| `claudetto/goal` | `check command and Stop hook` | The built-in evaluator reads only the conversation, so it cannot run a check (trim design). `/goal` is now one check command that the `Stop` hook runs. | The built-in `/goal` runs checks. |
| `claudetto/ground` | `source check` | Claude wrote a number, a `file:line` reference, or a convention (`npx` in a `bun` project) with no source (trim design, step 9). | Claude cites only sources that exist, shown by a replay with no false claim. |
| `claudetto/guard` | `permission gate` | The settings lists cannot read a command, so they cannot tell `rm -rf node_modules` from `rm -rf src` (see [Guard](Guard)). | Claude Code reads a command and the `git` state of its paths in its own rules. |
| `claudetto/hygiene` | `session cleanup` | Claude Code leaves `fswatch-probe-*` folders (anthropics/claude-code#104170), and old session files stay (see [Session Hygiene](Hygiene)). | Claude Code removes them. |
| `claudetto/hygiene` | `edit ledger` | Claude cannot know that a file changed after its last edit when the user or a tool changed it (see [Session Hygiene](Hygiene)). | Claude Code tells Claude when a file changes. |
| `claudetto/handoff` | `compact answer` | A compaction costs much and loses the state of the work (trim design, decision 6). | Claude Code compaction keeps the state at the same cost. |
| `claudetto/handoff` | `second compaction update` | The first handoff `H1` stayed inside `H2` at a second compaction (commit `9914887a`, D46). | The compact answer is removed. |
| `claudetto/handoff` | `model switch warning` | A `/model` switch drops a warm prompt cache, and the new model writes the whole context again (D47). | The built-in confirmation of Claude Code shows the cost of the cache write. |
| `claudetto/prompt` | `main agent body` | The built-in prompts are bad (the user, trim decision 3). | Claude Code ships a short prompt that needs no tailor. |
| `claudetto/prompt` | `context, tool, and attachment cuts` | The built-in prompts are bad (the user, trim decision 3). | Claude Code has a setting for each cut. |
| `claudetto/reply` | `reply button` | the user copied messages of Claude by hand to answer them (the user, 2026-10-18) | Claude Code has its own action that quotes a message in the prompt. |
